exposure: Pregnancy in women with kidney transplants
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 35 kidney transplant recipients experiencing a total of 37 pregnancies between 2012 and 2021 at a tertiary care center in Saudi Arabia.
finding: Pregnancy after kidney transplantation, while carrying inherent risks and higher maternal and neonatal complication rates than the general population, can achieve favorable outcomes with vigilant monitoring and multidisciplinary care, with most patients maintaining stable long-term graft function despite transient declines.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were performed in 74% of cases, predominantly due to fetal distress.
birth_weight: 63% of infants were born with normal birth weight
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 35 weeks, with 57% of pregnancies reaching term.
